snippet.title: Denshattack! – Indie World Showcase 3.3.2026
snippet.description:
Denshattack!, the train-tricking extreme platformer, launches for Nintendo Switch 2 on June 17, 2026! Download the demo today: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/denshattack-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Travel across a dystopian Japan racking up points and facing bizarre bosses in this fast-paced action-adventure.

Buy Denshattack! on launch day to get an exclusive train skin.

#IndieWorld #Denshattack #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
